positions.label: Foundation
positions.meaning: The ground you are starting from: what supports the situation, or what you are taking for granted.
positions.name: foundation

positions.label: Tension
positions.meaning: Read against the foundation: what complicates it, challenges it, or asks for a different response.
positions.name: tension

positions.label: Next step
positions.meaning: A possible response to that tension: something to try or attend to, rather than a promised outcome.
positions.name: next_step

positions.label: Focus
positions.meaning: A single lens on your question. Notice what fits your experience and what does not.
positions.name: focus

tarot.description: Complete 78-card text deck. Original Cleromancy reflective prompts, not historical translations or reproduced artwork. Correspondence traditions are independent overlays, not claims about the deck maker. Minor-card prompts are fixed GPT-6/Codex-assisted editorial templates; major prompts preserve the earlier authored text. No per-reading prose generation.
